image_description: A modern interior scene featuring a striking red staircase with glass balustrades and metal handrails. The stairs ascend diagonally from left to right. At the base of the stairs, there is a small red wheelchair or mobility device. To the right, a potted plant sits on the floor. The background includes white structural columns, glass walls, and reflections on a polished dark floor.

The underside of the red staircase appears somewhat flat and lacks the expected structural depth or stringer details. The connection points to the floor and wall are vague.
Reflections on the glass panels are inconsistent with the environment. Some reflections appear smeared or do not align with the light sources visible in the ceiling.
The handrail ends blend slightly into the background/wall without a clear mounting bracket or termination cap, suggesting minor fusion artifacts.
